plugins.Author: Ice
plugins.Name: Gather & Chill
plugins.Punchline: The gathering companion that we all needed.
plugins.Description: A gathering plugin that will help you with your gathering needs. Between gathering items for you, or self applying buffs to make the task of gathering monotonous.
plugins.Changelog:
- Cordials now have a node type restriction allowance
	- You can set if you want to (or not) used them for ephemeral, legendary, and normal nodes
- Collectables got a little bit of a logic overall
	- Short end, less strict and less following the TC guide... this might backfire on me, but allows for being a bit more reserved in gp usage. Will probably still fine tweak this as time goes on
- Collectables also have a setting to set which goal you would like to go for (high/mid/low)
- General gatherables have profiles that can be assigned with rules
	- The baseline is still there, if you don't feel like fucking with it, you don't have to
	- Allows for setting a minimum maximum integrity to allow for specific buffs to be used
	- I haven't tested this *-extensively-*, but for ya'll who want to nit pick which buffs you wanna use, it's there now
- Added a calculator for gatherable as well, that way you can tell what you're roughly going to gather based on what you have enabled for that profile
- Gathering also has a replay built into it, it'll track
	- What you gathered at a node
	- What buffs it used
	- How many items you got
	- This is mainly so I can actually tell what's being used on gathering nodes, and why certain things aren't. 
- Maps have been told they are *-in fact-* hidden items (they weren't in the sheets, so now... well now they are)

plugins.Changelog: - More bugfixes/attempts at fixing that damn selling bug

plugins.Author: Ice
plugins.Name: Chilled Leves
plugins.Punchline: I heard you like your leves on the rocks.
plugins.Description: The leve plugin that nobody wanted to make. Will display what leves you need to complete, as well as help automate them for your heart desires (not required though)
plugins.Changelog:
- Added a minimum interaction delay before event attempting to do anything with grabbing leves
	- It's 100ms
	- This is moreso to prevent people from crashing due to (what I can only assume) to be ping -> server information
	- The setting takes a higher priority, so if you set it to like 500, it'll respect the 500
- Fixed an issue where (L) leves weren't being considered for grabbing even though they were the only thing left
- Fixed an issue where the level check just... didn't level check??? (woops)
- Fixed an issue where the cost amount wasn't working as intended

plugins.Author: Ice
plugins.Name: Ice's Cosmic Exploration (ICE)
plugins.Punchline: Welcome to, the dark side of, the MOOOON
plugins.Description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!
plugins.Changelog: - Cosmic will only enable autohook if it needs to start a fishing mission, will not try and disable it.
